verses.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਧਿਆਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: pooran braham dhiaan pooran braham giaan pooran bhagat satigur upadhes hai ||

en.bdb: Satguru's sermon (in the form of blessing of Naam) is complete contemplation of the Master Lord, His knowledge and is total worship.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਜਲੁ ਆਪਾ ਖੋਇ ਬਰਨ ਬਰਨ ਮਿਲੈ ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਬਿਬੇਕੀ ਪਰਮਾਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਵੇਸ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise jal aapaa khoi baran baran milai taise hee bibekee paramaatam praves hai ||

en.bdb: As water mixes with several colours and acquires the same hue, similarly a disciple following Guru's advice becomes one with God.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸਿ ਜੈਸੇ ਕਨਿਕ ਅਨਿਕ ਧਾਤੁ ਚੰਦਨ ਬਨਾਸਪਤੀ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਆਵੇਸ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: paaras paras jaise kanik anik dhaat cha(n)dhan banaasapatee baasanaa aaves hai ||

en.bdb: As many metals when touched with philosopher stone become gold, bushes and plants grown in the vicinity of sandalwood attain its fragrance, similarly a devotee following Guru's advice becomes pure and one who spreads the fragrance of goodness all around.

verses.gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਪੂਰਮ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਜੋਤਿ ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਆਦਿ ਕਉ ਅਦੇਸ ਹੈ ॥੧੩੩॥
verses.translit_en: ghaT ghaT pooram braham jot ot pot bhaavanee bhagat bhai aadh kau adhes hai ||133||

en.bdb: Making prayers and supplications to the Almighty Lord, a wise and rationalist person enjoins the divine radiance of the Omnipresent Lord like warp and weft of a fabric through complete faith and devotion instilled in him by the Guru. (133)
